Changes.note: Assigning makes the person you chose the scope's köşk nazımı, başmüderris or hoca (and its imam); the scope is active again and leaves the list. The person starts managing it with the role's permissions; with an end date, the post ends by itself at that moment. The assignment is written to the audit log, and so is every e-mail search. There is no undo on this page: the post is removed on the scope's own management page.
